mapper.sql: id, version_id AS versionId, user_id AS userId, contributor_name AS contributorName, contributor_role AS contributorRole, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT dvc.id, dvc.version_id AS versionId, dvc.user_id AS userId, dvc.contributor_name AS contributorName, dvc.contributor_role AS contributorRole, DATE_FORMAT(dvc.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, u.uid AS uid, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar AS avatar, COALESCE(u.nickname, dvc.contributor_name, '匿名') AS displayName FROM dialogue_version_contributor dvc LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = dvc.user_id WHERE dvc.version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY dvc.contributor_role, dvc.id

SELECT dvc.user_id AS userId, MAX(u.uid) AS uid, MAX(u.nickname) AS nickname, MAX(u.avatar) AS avatar, dvc.contributor_name AS contributorName, COALESCE(MAX(u.nickname), dvc.contributor_name, '匿名') AS displayName, COUNT(DISTINCT dv.id) AS versionCount FROM dialogue_version dv INNER JOIN dialogue_version_contributor dvc ON dvc.version_id = dv.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = dvc.user_id WHERE dv.source_type = #{sourceType} AND dv.source_id = #{sourceId} AND dvc.contributor_role = 1 GROUP BY dvc.user_id, dvc.contributor_name ORDER BY versionCount DESC, userId
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dialogue_version_contributor (version_id, user_id, contributor_name, contributor_role) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{userId}, #{contributorName}, #{contributorRole})
